name: BACH_0161
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests InSitu (93%)** · Unreliable input · Careful review
Simulated frozen section is flagged unreliable and cannot exclude Invasive [F1]; defer margin call to permanent sections [F10].

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Top probabilities | InSitu 93%, Invasive 5%, Benign 2%, Normal 0% | Favors InSitu; 5% invasive risk |
| Conformal set | InSitu, Invasive (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Cannot exclude Invasive at 90% |
| Reliability / OOD | Reliability 35% (flagged), OOD 62% [F6] | Suspect input; recut/levels drafted |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Disagree (false) | Foundation models disagree on top |
| Similar cases | 4/5 InSitu (80%); 1 Invasive (89%) [F5] | Mostly InSitu; close Invasive neighbor |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 7, 11) · ↓ invasive · Pushes away from invasive (-0.282) [F2]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Dense lymphocytic infiltrate (TILs)** (region 6) · context · Descriptive score (+0.258) [F3]; 8/20 AI spot check · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 3) · ↓ invasive · Typical level pushes down (-0.174) [F4]; 0/20 AI spot check · Unreliable
- **Tumor cell fraction & density** (regions 2, 5, 9) · context · 87% neoplastic (100th percentile) [F7]; 3765/mm² density (97th percentile) [F8] · Measured

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful to classifier; removing top-risk regions drops invasive probability (+0.0114 vs random, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197).
- **Concepts**: Unproven faithfulness (deletion CI -0.0088–0.0064 includes 0); `normal_lobules`, `mitoses`, and `necrosis` are Unreliable (0–3/20 AI spot checks).

## Could be wrong if
- Low reliability (35%, simulated frozen section) masks invasion, matching close Invasive neighbor BACH_0138 (89% similarity).
- Invasion exists in regions 8–9 or deeper levels, as CONCH–MUSK disagreement and the conformal set warn.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 8, 9**: Inspect for stromal invasion at the highest heatmap risk areas (4% regional risk).
2. **Regions 7, 11**: Check stromal infiltration and pleomorphism (validated concepts) against Invasive contrast case BACH_0138.
3. **Regions 2, 5, 9**: Verify duct confinement in dense tumor [F9]; consider drafted recut H&E and deeper levels.
